data.case_title: Rehabilitation application rejected by Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn
data.title: Rejection of rehabilitation application (Ablehnung medizinische Rehabilitation)
data.summary: The Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for a stationary medical rehabilitation (medizinische Rehabilitation), stating her earning capacity is not significantly at risk and the prescribed outpatient physiotherapy is sufficient. The decision is dated 18 November 2026 and was sent on Saturday, 21 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is a rejection decision (Ablehnungsbescheid) from the pension insurance, not an invoice. You may decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to this decision; the app shows until when you can still do so based on the one-month period after notification. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You can also apply again at any time if your symptoms get worse. If you disagree with the medical assessment, it may help to get advice from a patient advice service (Patientenberatung) or a lawyer specialising in social law.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to object to the rejection of your rehabilitation application, and if so, submit the objection in writing or in person at the Rentenversicherung office
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.

items.title: Reapply if symptoms worsen
items.action: If your health problems get worse, you can submit a new application for rehabilitation at any time
items.quote: Verschlechtern sich Ihre Beschwerden, können Sie jederzeit einen neuen Antrag stellen.
